member_outcomes.reasoning: Inspected the complete one-page ProQuest replica. EO2980, signed October 24,1918, suspends the eight-hour prohibition only for persons/firms/corporations engaged in construction and completion of four or more described launches. The quoted statutory overtime safeguard qualifies that relief. Construction is the limiting subject, not proof that any launch was completed. Neither fiscal-year language in the statute title nor war purpose supplies the first ending. No actor or own-term ending evidence is carried. Material OCR defects and unexamined statutory/completion evidence prevent a whole-case proposal.
member_outcomes.earlier_end_check: No held evidence establishes actual launch completion or an earlier extinguishing source. The relief begins from/after October24,1918; a starting date cannot be recast as cessation.
member_outcomes.scope_check: Relief is limited to construction/completion of the described launches, with the quoted statutory overtime proviso. Not an order to construct them; no worldwide waiver or unproved wartime sunset.
member_outcomes.independent_command_check: The suspension and its quoted wage limitation must be assessed together; construction is scope, while any accrued wages/contract rights are consequences requiring separate treatment.
member_outcomes.savings_check: The quoted wage proviso preserves a distinct overtime safeguard; possible accrued wage/contract consequences require evidence and are not extinguished by assumed completion.
